label: O-1A — Achterberg, Halcyon Vision Labs
text:
Halcyon Vision Labs, Inc. petitions for O-1A classification on behalf of Dr. Simone Achterberg, Principal Research Scientist, A128-773-410, USCIS receipt IOE0912345671, passport PA3847562.

The enclosed exhibits establish that Dr. Achterberg is among the small percentage who has risen to the very top of machine-learning research. She is the only researcher to win the Halvorsen Prize twice, and The Compute Dispatch's feature on her reasoning-benchmark work documents sustained national and international acclaim. Her compensation, $215,000 with $4,200,000 in dedicated grant funding, reflects Halcyon's determination to keep the individual the field has recognized as irreplaceable to its reasoning-model program.

We respectfully request approval of this petition.

This consultation letter and the accompanying exhibits are submitted pursuant to 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(o) and reflect counsel's good-faith review of the beneficiary's extraordinary ability record.

Naomi Castellanos-Reyes, Esq.
Castellanos Immigration Partners LLC

label: O-1A — Umeh, Terraform Grid Systems
text:
Terraform Grid Systems, Inc. petitions for O-1A classification on behalf of its founder and CEO, Adaeze Umeh, A134-902-661, USCIS receipt IOE0912345682, passport GX1928374.

The enclosed exhibits establish that Ms. Umeh has risen to the very top of the grid-software sector. She was named to Continuum Ventures' Founders Vanguard List two years running, and Ledger & Circuit's profile of the company's $18,500,000 Series A documents the acclaim that raise received across the industry. Her compensation, $260,000, is deliberately modest relative to the value the board believes she has created, evidence that her recognition rests on achievement rather than salary alone.

We respectfully request approval of this petition.

This consultation letter and the accompanying exhibits are submitted pursuant to 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(o) and reflect counsel's good-faith review of the beneficiary's extraordinary ability record.

Naomi Castellanos-Reyes, Esq.
Castellanos Immigration Partners LLC

label: O-1B — Duarte-Kowalski, Salt & Timber
text:
Salt & Timber Hospitality Group, LLC petitions for O-1B classification on behalf of its executive chef, Ines Duarte-Kowalski, A119-284-556, USCIS receipt IOE0912345693, passport LK9302847.

The enclosed exhibits establish extraordinary ability and sustained acclaim in the culinary arts. Chef Duarte-Kowalski is the only chef to receive the Continental Guild of Culinary Arts' Emberstone Medal in two consecutive years, and Plate & Province's feature on Ember & Salt documents the national attention her tasting menu has drawn. Her compensation, $185,000 plus a $25,000 relocation bonus, reflects the group's commitment to a kitchen built around retaining her.

We respectfully request approval of this petition.

This consultation letter and the accompanying exhibits are submitted pursuant to 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(o) and reflect counsel's good-faith review of the beneficiary's extraordinary ability record.

Naomi Castellanos-Reyes, Esq.
Castellanos Immigration Partners LLC
